# W0001: commented-out code

Commented-out code goes stale while readers take it as true. Delete it; version control keeps it.

- Rule: [`lexical.commented-out-code`](../../reference/02-lexical.md#lexical.commented-out-code)
- Reported at: the comment.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `warnings` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt W0001:2
fn total(prices: List<i64>) -> i64 {
  // let discount = 10
  prices.fold(0, |sum, p| sum + p)
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn total(prices: List<i64>) -> i64 {
  prices.fold(0, |sum, p| sum + p)
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`W0001_commented_out_code.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/W0001_commented_out_code.lt):

```text
── COMMENTED-OUT CODE ───────────────── W0001_commented_out_code.lt:2:3  [W0001]

This comment holds code:

  2 │   // let discount = 10
    │   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

Commented-out code goes stale while readers take it as true. Delete it; version
control keeps it.

To fix it, delete the comment:

  2 │   // let discount = 10
    │   --------------------
```
